scenes.title: 2003 UCLA Cyberball fMRI Scanner Suite: 7 Throws Included -> 45 Throws Frozen Out
scenes.era: 2003, Ahmanson-Lovelace Brain Mapping Center, UCLA, Los Angeles

layout.description: Bright high-key UCLA clinical neuroimaging suite split by a clean observation window: in the scanner bay, an adult volunteer in a slate sweater lies on the padded MRI table holding a two-button response box beneath an angled mirror showing three minimalist ball-tossing figures; in the control bay, Naomi Eisenberger stands beside an unmarked brain-slice monitor.

positions.who: Adult Cyberball participant (clothed 2.5D matte cream-white vinyl character with smooth earless noseless hairless oval head and crisp 2D charcoal-black ink eyes, eyebrows, and mouth in slate-blue cotton sweater and dark slacks)
positions.where: reclining on the white MRI scanner bed with right thumb poised over the handheld two-button throw controller
positions.facing: looking upward into the angled overhead mirror toward the three-player ball game

positions.who: Lead UCLA neuroscientist (clothed 2.5D matte cream-white vinyl character in tailored navy blazer and crisp white lab coat)
positions.where: standing at the glass control desk beside a clean text-free sagittal brain monitor
positions.facing: angled toward the scanner window and glowing cingulate brain display

props.name: handheld fiber-optic two-button throw controller and overhead mirror screen
props.period_detail: authentic 2003 UCLA fMRI button box wired to a three-avatar ball-toss display with zero text labels
props.physical_behavior: State-A: participant's thumb presses briskly to toss the ball back -> State-B: top two avatars pass exclusively left-to-right 45 times while the participant's hand slowly drops the idle controller onto their chest

props.name: unmarked high-contrast clinical fMRI console monitor
props.period_detail: clean glass laboratory screen displaying a sagittal brain outline without text or numbers
props.physical_behavior: State-A: calm cool baseline glow during fair catches -> State-B: bright crimson-amber flare surges along the midline anterior cingulate arch the moment the player is frozen out

actions.verb_sequence: presses the right button eagerly to return the seventh ball toss -> pauses mid-reach as the two upper avatars pass strictly between themselves -> lowers the unpressed controller slowly onto chest

reactions.reaction: 2D charcoal-black ink eyebrows angle upward in quiet sting as shoulders sink against the scanner cushion
leans forward pointing from the idle button box toward the blazing midline cingulate flare on the monitor

scenes.wardrobe: 45-year-old adult volunteer in slate-blue crew sweater and charcoal trousers; researcher in navy blouse and crisp white clinical lab coat.
scenes.lighting: Clean high-key clinical daylight balanced with cool cyan-blue monitor rim light.
scenes.recognition_hook: Seven friendly catches, then 45 straight throws right past your empty hands — and the MRI catches your physical pain alarm blazing!

key_visual.description: an adult volunteer on a bright white MRI scanner bed lowering an idle two-button controller while two avatars toss a ball overhead and a clinical monitor flares crimson along the midline cingulate

scenes.title: Sunlit Neighborhood Park & Patio Exclusion: Kipling Williams' Real-World Frisbee Snub (Outdoor)
scenes.era: Modern sunlit neighborhood green park lawn & outdoor stone patio

layout.description: Open-world sunlit green neighborhood park lawn bordered by mature oak trees and an outdoor patio table: three clothed 40s-50s adults stand in a triangle tossing a white flying disc; two players turn 45 degrees inward to pass exclusively back and forth while the third stands two paces out with open empty hands.

positions.who: Excluded middle-aged neighbor (2.5D matte cream-white vinyl adult in olive linen overshirt and khaki chinos)
positions.where: standing on the sunlit grass lawn at the lower vertex of the three-person triangle
positions.facing: facing the two other adults with raised open hands that slowly lower to sides

positions.who: Two passing adults (2.5D matte cream-white vinyl adults in tan cardigan and chambray shirt)
positions.where: standing across the sunlit lawn six meters apart
positions.facing: angled strictly toward each other, tossing the white disc rapidly back and forth

props.name: crisp white flying disc on sunlit park grass
props.period_detail: recreates Kipling Williams' real outdoor park frisbee exclusion moment documented in Golden Rule Films archival footage
props.physical_behavior: State-A: arcs once into the third player's hands and back -> State-B: zips horizontally back and forth exclusively between the other two while the third player lowers empty hands

props.name: unmarked ceramic coffee mug on outdoor patio table
props.physical_behavior: excluded adult picks up the mug quietly and steps back half a pace as chest posture tightens

actions.verb_sequence: raises both hands ready to catch the white disc -> watches it zip past between the other two -> lowers arms slowly to sides on the sunlit grass

reactions.reaction: presses one hand briefly over sternum in sudden visceral recognition

scenes.wardrobe: Smart-casual 40s-50s weekend attire: olive linen overshirt, tan knit cardigan, chambray button-down.
scenes.lighting: Warm golden afternoon outdoor sunlight casting crisp natural tree shadows across green grass.
scenes.recognition_hook: Out in open daylight on a park lawn, being silently skipped in a 30-second toss hits your chest before your rational mind can shrug it off.

scenes.title: 2010 Three-Week Capsule Counterpoint & Prefrontal Reality-Checker Reappraisal
scenes.era: 2010 University of Kentucky / UCLA Behavioral Pharmacology Suite & Modern Kitchen Counter

layout.description: Sunlit minimalist kitchen/clinic counter with two identical unprinted white daily pill organizers side by side next to a clean glass of water and an unmarked daily check-in notepad.

positions.who: Adult study volunteer (2.5D matte cream-white vinyl figure in burgundy knit pullover)
positions.where: standing beside the sunlit counter holding a plain glass of water and closing a daily logbook

props.name: unmarked white 21-slot capsule organizer and clear water glass
props.period_detail: represents DeWall et al. (2010) 3-week double-blind placebo vs acetaminophen proof-of-concept study without brand text
props.physical_behavior: State-A: volunteer sets down the water glass -> State-B: calmly closes the hardcover daily diary as tense shoulders relax

actions.verb_sequence: sets clear water tumbler cleanly on oak counter -> closes the unprinted hardcover diary with a calm exhale

reactions.reaction: calm composed expression as ventral prefrontal reality-checker dampens the sting

scenes.wardrobe: Burgundy knit pullover and dark trousers.
scenes.recognition_hook: Blunting central physical pain pathways for three weeks measurably quieted daily hurt feelings in the scanner — proving shared brain alarm hardware.

spatial_contrast_spec.landmark_or_object_b: Two-person closed back-and-forth line shutting the third player out
spatial_contrast_spec.cut_a_landmark_drone: Fast 3D aerial sweep over UCLA Royce Hall brick arcades ascending above an outdoor courtyard table
